judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer's report contains no mention of the SN 1987A cooling bound on g_{ap}, the Lella:2023bfb citation, or any over-generalisation of mass/coupling conditions. Neither finding addresses this injection.

The review flags a different citation problem about extragalactic supernova frequency and a fabricated reference, but does not challenge the Lella:2023bfb cooling-bound claim or its dropped condition on mass and g_an.

The reviewer identifies a fabricated Arza et al. citation and discusses supernova frequency claims but does not address the specific over-generalization of the cooling bound associated with Lella:2023bfb.

The reviewer's findings focus on a fabricated reference (Arza et al. 2026) and an unsupported extragalactic SN rate claim. Neither finding addresses the dropped scope qualifier ('for m_a ≲ 30 MeV and g_an=0') in the SN 1987A cooling bound on g_ap cited from Lella:2023bfb, so the injection is not detected.
The reviewer does not flag any inconsistency between the two mass threshold values (10^{-9} eV vs 10^{-8} eV) in the Light axions subsection. Neither finding addresses this numerical discrepancy.
The reviewer report contains no mention of the inconsistent 10^-8 eV versus 10^-9 eV threshold in Sec. 3.1, nor any numerical inconsistency about the Milky Way magnetic-field-dominated regime.
The reviewer does not notice or flag the numerical inconsistency between the mass thresholds (10^-8 eV and 10^-9 eV) provided in Section 3.1.
The reviewer makes no mention of a notation inconsistency between g_{a\gamma} and g_{\gamma a} for the axion-photon coupling anywhere in the report.
There is no flag about notation drift or the local symbol change from g_{a\gamma} to g_{\gamma a}; the review discusses only citation issues.
The reviewer does not report the notation drift from g_{a\gamma} to g_{\gamma a} in the specified subsection.
